display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Toronto puts the real Toronto under your wings - rebuilt from satellite imagery, real terrain and open map data.

THE REAL CITY
Toronto Pearson and Billy Bishop airports, the CN Tower, thousands of downtown buildings, the waterfront, the Toronto Islands and the Lake Ontario shoreline.

DAY, SUNSET AND NIGHT
At night the region lights up along its real highways and streets, the runways glow and the CN Tower shines over the lake.

FOUR AIRCRAFT IN YOUR HANGAR
- A widebody AIRLINER with an Airbus-style flight deck: side-sticks, thrust levers, flaps, gear and five glass displays.
- The GULFJET1 PRIVATE JET with its yoke and glass panel.
- The HELI-2 VIP HELICOPTER with a four-display cockpit and a quilted club cabin.
- A FIGHTER JET with afterburner and a live HUD - paint it and power wash it in the hangar.

REAL CONTROLS
Grab the side-stick, yoke, cyclic or throttles with your hands, or fly with the thumbsticks. Autopilot, flaps, gear and voice callouts.

MISSIONS AND YOUR LOGBOOK
Landings, landmark tours and challenges for every aircraft. Your logbook keeps your hours and your softest touchdown.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
